review_fixes.what: e2e harness: a11y.spec.ts runs every route, including the three that live on the Vite dev server (dev-visual-gallery, dev-review, dev-review-matrices), but the isolated config starts that server only with HB_DEV_SERVER=1. Without it those tests went to 127.0.0.1:4175: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED here (6 failures in each of chromium 1/3 and webkit 1/3), or, worse, whatever another workstream serves there (which is how they could pass before). The isolated config now sets HB_NO_DEV_SERVER=1 when it starts no dev server, and a11y.spec.ts's setUp skips a devServer route then, with the reason; the HB_DEV_SERVER=1 runs check them.

The base config (npm run e2e) always starts the dev server and never sets the variable, so its runs are unchanged.

flaky: e2e/keyboard-session.spec.ts:470 (chromium, webkit): wall-clock dependent. The ?fast=1 practice block keeps running while the 'Skip Reaction Time?' panel is open, so under CPU load it can end before 'Keep going' hands focus back, and .stage is gone. Passes alone. Already an open issue of w2-sync; making it robust means either waiting on the trial state in the test or pausing the block while the panel is open (a product decision).

e2e/session-save.spec.ts:289 whole ?fast=1 session (chromium, webkit, iphone): 'rt_simple: valid trials' below min_valid when the machine is loaded. The 20x fast clock scales the 150-1,500 ms valid window down to 7.5-75 ms of real time, so a driver slowed by load answers 'too slow'. Passes alone on all three projects (19/19 each). Same as w2-perf and w2-session reported.

open_issues: Product decision (not taken): an RT block, practice or counted, keeps running while a 'Skip' or 'Finish now?' panel is open, so trials pass unanswered while the person reads it. That is what makes keyboard-session.spec.ts:470 wall-clock dependent; pausing the block under the panel would change the RT procedure, so it was left (w2-sync named it too).

web/src/session/Ready.svelte (wave 1, UX-012a): load() returns the read already under way, so a second file chosen while the first is still being read is not read, and if the first was not a save the field is cleared under the second. Unreachable in practice (choosing a second file means opening the picker again; a save is read in milliseconds), so left as is; a queued re-read plus clearing the field only if it still holds the failed file would close it.

web/src/session/Ready.svelte (wave 1): with a file loaded, pasting a different code and pressing Load does nothing (the file in the field wins and is already loaded), with no message. This follows the documented order (the file first, the code only when there is no file or it is not a save) but could surprise; an owner view may want the newer input to win or a line that says the file is used.

The isolated e2e config used to send a11y.spec.ts's dev-server routes to 127.0.0.1:4175 without starting a server there, so wave-1 isolated runs may have checked those three routes against another worktree's dev server. Fixed above (they are skipped without HB_DEV_SERVER=1); a full isolated pass now needs one HB_DEV_SERVER=1 run per project for them, as this integration did.

e2e helpers duplicated across the new specs (not merged at integration, to keep wave 2 as tested): a no-WebGL init script exists in e2e/routes.ts (NO_WEBGL), e2e/ux-render.spec.ts (inline) and e2e/ux2-session.spec.ts (noWebGlSpatial); e2e/ux2-perf.spec.ts has its own toReady(page, driver, beforeReady) beside flow.ts toReady(page).

The w2-session panel message has role='status' and is inserted together with its text, as the renderer's note was; some screen readers do not announce a live region that arrives with its content (the w2-session deviation says so). The Skip button is the first thing in the panel and the heading stays, so the condition is still found by reading on.
